heading: HELLO, I'M HARRY.
body:
Harry Brian Studio is an independent illustration and creative design studio creating bright, playful artwork with a big love of colour and character.

The studio combines bold visual storytelling with a joyful spirit, creating work that celebrates the humour in everyday life and the simple power of making people smile. Built on the belief that illustration can spark both laughter and comfort, my work explores whimsical, humorous and sometimes cheeky subjects - often featuring the occasional partly naked (and hairy) man!

I work across personal commissions, freelance projects and wholesale artwork, creating illustrations that feel friendly, distinctive, full of personality and, above all, joyful.
